title: Long-Distance Universality for the Berger Sphere and the Unicycle
description: Proofs of two claims of Brown, Freedman, Lin and Susskind on one-qubit complexity geometry: the Berger-sphere distance changes by at most pi/(2 sqrt I) as the penalty factor I tends to infinity, and the unicycle parking cost is z + 2 sqrt(1 - 1/I) + O(1/z).
